request: Prepare a45-minute lesson finding the possible number of cooperative members voting in either ballot and in both. Require feasible endpoint allocations and distinguish the ranges from an actual turnout count.
objective: Derive joint participation bounds from two internally deduplicated lists within one unchanged member register.

sources.text: Fictional cooperative register: fifty-seven members were eligible throughout the two ballots, with no membership changes. Both ballots were restricted to this register.
The venue ballot lists thirty-one distinct voters. The timetable ballot lists thirty-four distinct voters. Each member appears at most once within each ballot list.
The lists have not been matched across ballots. Ballot choices are secret and are not included; the records count voters, not preferences.
